title: A quiet night mode
description: A favorite recording, a soft screen and a timer, with nothing extra to do in the middle of the night.

blocks.text: Someone who has woken up may need a familiar story, not a new collection. Setting everything up again gets in the way of going back to rest.

quote.text: For some reason so many nights and wake up at 3 AM and cannot go back to sleep for at least an hour. Now I know to put on my noise canceling headphones with a sleep story, and I get back to sleep much quicker.

blocks.text: Save the recording, the volume and the stop time. When the app is opened at night, show only the continuation and a few clear settings.
Test the end of a recording: autoplay, an ad or a loud cue can ruin the whole scenario even when the content is good.
